nodes.label: Webhook Security Flow
nodes.rationale: Webhooks must use provider-specific verification, deduplication, and audit logging before processing.

nodes.label: Audit Logging System
nodes.rationale: Append-only design for immutability; logs organization, user, action, and resource metadata.

nodes.label: Deployment Safety
nodes.rationale: Includes health checks, audit logs, and optional manager approval for high-risk projects.

nodes.label: PaymentProvider Interface
nodes.rationale: Common interface for Stripe and Dojo to abstract provider-specific implementation details from staff.

nodes.label: RBAC & RLS Testing
nodes.rationale: Explicit tests to ensure cross-tenant isolation and role-based access at the database level.

nodes.label: Global Search
nodes.rationale: Search results must enforce RBAC and exclude sensitive information like salary or secrets unless authorized.

nodes.label: HR & Salary Architecture
nodes.rationale: Highly sensitive module requiring dedicated permissions; separates general staff management from financial salary records.

nodes.label: Architectural Decisions
nodes.rationale: Records major architectural changes and the criteria for documenting them.

nodes.label: Business Operations MVP
nodes.rationale: Second milestone focusing on Payments (Stripe/Dojo) and CRM.

nodes.label: Infrastructure MVP
nodes.rationale: First major functional milestone focusing on Auth, RBAC, and Domain/DNS management.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.rationale: Contains Next.js agent rules and warnings about breaking changes in specific Next.js versions.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Project operating manual and guide for using graphify tools.

nodes.label: Environment Matrix
nodes.rationale: Defines service configurations (Supabase, Payments, APIs) across LOCAL, TEST, STAGING, and PRODUCTION.

nodes.label: Master Implementation Spec
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive blueprint for the SaaS platform, including architecture, security, and feature roadmaps.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.rationale: Standard project entry point describing the Next.js bootstrap and development commands.

nodes.label: DNS Safety & Rollback
nodes.rationale: Requires snapshots before mutation and diff previews for high-risk records (NS, MX, CAA).

nodes.label: Payment Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Scheduled reconciliation job to handle missing webhooks and update local database state.

nodes.label: Realtime Notification Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses Supabase Realtime Broadcast for delivery but must be backed by a durable notifications table.

nodes.label: Safe DNS Workflow
nodes.rationale: Requires preview, impact warning, explicit confirmation, and post-change verification for high-impact records like NS, MX, and CAA.

nodes.label: Durable Job Processing
nodes.rationale: Operations requiring retries or long-running execution must use a durable job mechanism (PostgreSQL-backed or managed queue) rather than in-memory tasks.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture
nodes.rationale: The system is designed as a single Next.js application containing well-separated business modules to lower initial complexity while maintaining clear boundaries.

nodes.label: Payment Architecture
nodes.rationale: Separates business requests from provider-specific implementations (Stripe/Dojo) using signed webhooks, idempotency, and reconciliation.

nodes.label: Provider Adapter Layer
nodes.rationale: All external integrations (GitHub, Vercel, Stripe, etc.) must be isolated behind provider adapters to ensure application modules depend on internal interfaces rather than vendor SDKs.

nodes.label: Audit & Observability
nodes.rationale: Mandatory recording of sensitive actions (role changes, DNS mods, payments) with correlation IDs for request/job/provider events.

nodes.label: Standard Request Flow
nodes.rationale: Mandatory sequence: Authenticate -> Resolve Identity -> Authorize -> Validate -> Execute Service -> Enforce Rules -> DB/Provider Call -> Audit -> Response.

nodes.label: WebRTC Signaling & Media
nodes.rationale: Uses Supabase Realtime for authenticated signaling and STUN/TURN for peer media transport; media streams are never stored in the database.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: Organization boundaries are foundational; enforced via organization_id, RLS, and server-side authorization to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.
